landmark_rule.landmark: ISO week, identified by its Monday date w (inherited H18.2/H18.3 weekly grid, freq W-MON from 2017-07-03)
landmark_rule.decision_time_t: t = w + 1 day at 00:00:00 UTC, i.e. the end of the landmark Monday. Every daily market row dated w is complete at t; nothing dated after w may enter X
landmark_rule.unit: (asset-era, landmark t); asset-era per inherited rule A7 (a new era starts only after > 365 days with no served route)
risk_set: asset-era week inside the inherited H18.2 exposure window (first served candle .. min(era end + 7 d, first delisting announcement))
asset age at w >= 90 days since the era's first served candle (inherited)
NEW in H20: landmark excluded if the era's delisting announcement time <= t (already public at t)
t + 365 d <= administrative censor 2026-10-09 (inherited), so the last landmark is w = 2025-10-06

target.name: y_365
target.definition: y(t, a) = 1 if asset-era a has its validated full-asset delisting ANNOUNCEMENT at time A with t < A <= t + 365 d; else 0
target.event_source: H18_1B_FULL_DELIST_EVENTS.parquet (frozen H18.1b lifecycle universe, 201 events); columns symbol, announcement_public_time
target.event_time: announcement_public_time (Binance CMS releaseDate, epoch ms -> naive UTC string, per scripts/h18_1b_discover.py); never trading_end
target.date_only_rule: a value without a time component denotes a UTC date D and is set to D 23:59:59 UTC (public by the end of D); with t at a UTC midnight this makes the start boundary unambiguous
target.parse_rule: strict: pandas.to_datetime(value, format='ISO8601'); timezone-naive values are UTC; any value that does not parse STOPS H20.3 as DATA / DESIGN FAILURE (no coercion to NaT, unlike H18.2)
target.era_join: event attaches to the asset-era of the same ticker with era_start <= A <= era_end + 30 d (inherited H18.2 rule); more than one matching era for any event STOPS H20.3 as DATA / DESIGN FAILURE; events matching no era are counted and reported as unmodellable (known: IDRT, VAI have no candles)
target.competing_exits: an era ending without an announcement (rebrand, merge, pair-removal-only exit) is a negative (inherited H18.3 definition)
not_used: y_365 / event_* / days_to_delist_announcement / ever_delisted columns of H18 panels (rebuilt instead, compared only as a reconstruction check after X is hashed)

block_roles.DEVELOPMENT: all fitting, selection and the 8 folds; 2018-01-01 .. 2023-12-25 (inherited H18.3 boundaries, chosen on calendar and follow-up grounds)
block_roles.EMBARGO_DROPPED: one horizon between development labels (mature by 2024-12-24) and the holdout; not used
block_roles.HOLDOUT_H20: opened exactly once, after the pre-holdout freeze; untouched by any H20 or context model. DISCLOSED: the same calendar block was the H18.3 holdout, opened in H18.3 for market-only models
block_roles.PROSPECTIVE_CONFIRMATION: landmarks whose outcomes are not yet observable (follow-up ends 2027-09-28); frozen now as the only block untouched by the whole research programme; evaluable only after a lifecycle refresh past 2027-09-28; not part of the H20.3 verdict

selection_basis: calendar and follow-up completeness only; no performance figure was read in choosing any date
label_overlap: a positive event at A is the label of every landmark t in [A - 365 d, A): up to 52 consecutive positive weeks per event; the folds' 365-day embargo removes train/test label overlap
